Backend: POST /api/chat/emotions/detect - Detects 'blij' emotion correctly
Backend: POST /api/chat/emotions/detect - Detects 'boos' emotion correctly
Backend: POST /api/chat/emotions/detect - Detects 'bang' emotion correctly
Backend: POST /api/chat/emotions/detect - Detects 'bedroefd' emotion correctly
Backend: POST /api/chat/emotions/detect - Returns no emotion for neutral text
Backend: POST /api/chat/emotions/detect - Returns source field (static/learned/both)

context_for_next_testing_agent: SparkBrainPage and EmotiesPage are fully functional. SparkBrainPage has static data (kernwaarden, identity). EmotiesPage fetches live data from 4 backend endpoints: /api/chat/emotions/state, /api/chat/emotions/learned, /api/chat/emotions/all, /api/chat/emotions/detect. All emotion detection uses hybrid system (static triggers + learned from knowledge cards). No mocked APIs - all endpoints are real and connected to JSON files.
